# Regression Review — warning-removal wave, partition: invoiceSystem, roofing, workflows, heatreach, warehouse, inventory, windows, flha, permits, sms, lighting

All 295 diff hunks across the 107 changed files in the partition were read and classified. `sms/**` had no changes. ~40 of the hunks belong to non-wave feature commits (heatreach 3D design view: design-scene/roof-tile/surface-shader/use-sharp-texture; leads rep-scoping) — scanned for the regression patterns, out of transform scope. Attribution was done per-file: 106 files carry ≥1 wave commit; 10 files were pure feature-commit territory.

## Flagged findings

**F1 — REGRESSION (minor, timing-dependent): `src/components/invoiceSystem/contractor-invoice-upload.tsx:278` — hunk intent: react-compiler fix converting functional-updater read into closure read + deps band-aid.**
- OLD (base, `onDrop` with `[]` deps): `setStagingFiles((prev) => { const updated = [...prev, ...newFiles]; if (updated.length > 1) { setProcessIndividually(true); } return updated; });` — the cumulative count was read **inside the functional updater**, i.e. always the latest queued state.
- NEW (HEAD): `const totalAfterAdd = stagingFiles.length + newFiles.length; setStagingFiles((prev) => [...prev, ...newFiles]); if (totalAfterAdd > 1) { setProcessIndividually(true); }` with `useCallback(..., [stagingFiles])`.
- Deviation: `processFiles` awaits per-file `FileReader` previews **before** `setStagingFiles`. If a second drop lands inside that window, its closure still sees the pre-first-drop `stagingFiles`. OLD: second drop's updater sees drop 1's files → cumulative > 1 → auto-enables individual processing. NEW: `totalAfterAdd` undercounts → **auto-enable of `processIndividually` is skipped**, so multiple invoices get merged into one processing group (the `!processIndividually` batch path).
